english.note: Use this when stoicism means the ability to endure pain or hardship rather than showing emotional indifference.

exampleSentences.english: After the operation, they showed great stoicism and never cried out in pain.
exampleSentences.traditional: 做完手術之後，佢仲係好有忍耐力，痛都冇叫過一聲。

english.note: Use this specifically for the ability to tolerate hardship, pain, or unpleasant conditions.

exampleSentences.english: Looking after a patient for a long time really tests your endurance.
exampleSentences.traditional: 長期照顧病人真係好考驗忍耐力。
exampleSentences.jyutping: coeng4 kei4 ziu3 gu3 beng6 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 haau2 jim6 jan2 noi6 lik6
